output.population: 322 moderately obese adults, mean age 52 years, with 86% men
output.intervention: Mediterranean restricted-calorie diet or low-carbohydrate non-restricted-calorie diet
output.outcome: Two-year weight change and metabolic outcomes
output.effect: Mean weight loss was 2.9 kg with low-fat, 4.4 kg with Mediterranean, and 4.7 kg with low-carbohydrate diets; total-to-HDL cholesterol ratio fell 20% with low-carbohydrate versus 12% with low-fat, and glycemic measures favored Mediterranean diet among 36 participants with diabetes.
output.applicability_boundary: Male-dominant sample; glycemic subgroup result was based on 36 participants with diabetes.
